CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and a separate origin/status entry for the same node shows organization/access metadata.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation or processing condition to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify content ('red') with coordinate-valued attributes.

D.rationale: The report lists identified content and separately records an origin/status object for the same node, distinguishing identity from status/organization.

O.rationale: Content entries are given within a structured node/candidate organization (current vs candidate nodes), describing how content is organized/presented in the model.
